newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price fell to $16.94 on Wednesday. [CORRECTED 11:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price fell to $16.94 on Wednesday. [CORRECTED 11:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects day in headline to Wednesday from Tuesday.)
The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes fell to $16.94 a barrel on Wednesday, down from $17.18 the previous day, the OPEC news agency said, quoting the OPEC Secretariat.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
